size_basis: study default envelope box, read back from the cad/stl registry (M0 study envelope; design sizing per the duty sheet follows)

machine.type: condensable knock-out vessel per the duty section 3 material row (316L, condensation, no carbon steel), in the FLUE_KO weir/launder idiom (FLOAT_SINK/FLUE_KO family): vertical 316L drum OD 540 (wall 8, study) with a laps-to-plinth base head and a top head, weir plate at the shell centreline (to z 360) dividing settle from overflow, launder trough at the +X side (lip top z 360); the IA-AHU-POT condensable slip (0.0521 kg/d) condenses against the cooled shell and the S70 condensables leave above the weir
machine.node_class: blank on the node - the tracker row says what is known; route hold carried by name (no AQS-PLAN-006 section 4 class; AFTERBURNER_FLUE/REE_RECOVER precedent)
machine.study_dims: shell OD/wall, weir and launder dimensions are study values (hold, WORK_ORDER W12)

sump_report.note: A-VES-style report from the model; the duty claims no holdup (section 8) - no residence time is derived from the model volume

machine.superseded_figures: the duty section 4 line 'Size 600 x 400 x 600 mm' and the placement seed 600 x 400 x 600 box predate the node size_mm study box - the node governs, the older figures are named holds (W12; the FLUE_KO precedent)
